answer: Every claim climbs the ember of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on gossip protocol threshold filtering that isolates unvouched swarm nodes. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
